text: Unconstrained mutual funds are proliferating at a significant rate, growing steadily since 2007, with the overall trend between 2010 and 2015 showing a steady increase in launches.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Unconstrained Mutual Funds and Retail Investor Protection (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2811729

isBasedOn.name: Unconstrained Mutual Funds and Retail Investor Protection

abstract: UMFs are proliferating at a significant rate. Figure 2 demonstrates that since 2007 the number of UMFs has grown at a steady pace. Although 2012 was a weaker year for UMF formation, the overall trend between 2010 and 2015 shows a steady increase in the launch of UMFs.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: fund inception data for the sample of 84 unconstrained mutual funds
